title: Kilagen tool inventory
description: One file per capability, listing tools that exist in that space. Reference material, never a recommendation and never an inventory of what you run — what you run is the estate's truth. Maintained in kilagenhq/tools and vendored into a release.

capability.description: The capability id this file covers, as in program/model/capabilities.yml.

updated.description: When this list was last reviewed. A list with no date is a list nobody has checked.

license.description: Deliberately two values. Which open-source licence, and which edition is free, changes too often to assert here.

note.description: One line, in our words, saying what it is. Never how good it is.
